If you want **online courses that combine shadow work with spiritual practice**, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **Awake Academy’s course directory**, **DailyOM’s *The Shadow Work Method to Heal***, and **Udemy’s shadow work courses** that explicitly include meditation, prayers, or spiritual development.[5][12][19][18]

A practical way to choose is to match the course to your goal:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | A more psychologically grounded introduction to shadow work | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a Jung psychology course series.[5][7] |
| **Awake Academy course directory** | A broader spiritual-development path | It combines shadow work, mindfulness, Western psychology, insight training, and Tibetan Buddhism.[12] |
| **The Shadow Work Method to Heal** (DailyOM) | Guided healing work with an intuitive/spiritual angle | The course uses shadow work to uncover psychological and energetic barriers.[19] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | A more devotional or practice-oriented format | It includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[18] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** (Udemy) | General self-mastery with spiritual framing | It emphasizes healing, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Work Essentials** (Udemy) | Technique-focused beginners | It focuses on techniques to uncover and heal exiled parts of the psyche.[6] |

If you want the **best overall balance of depth and credibility**, start with **Jung Platform** for shadow work grounded in Jungian psychology, then pair it with a more explicitly spiritual course such as **Awake Academy** or **DailyOM**.[5][12][19]

If you want the **most explicitly spiritual** options from the results, the best matches are **Awake Academy**, **Udemy’s Shadow Work Course and Workbook**, and **Udemy’s Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self**.[12][18][3]

A few selection tips:
- Choose **Jungian** courses if you want a more structured psychological framework.[5][7]
- Choose courses mentioning **meditations, prayers, energy cultivation, or Tibetan Buddhism** if you want stronger spiritual practice integration.[18][12][16]
- Choose **self-paced** courses if you want flexibility; several of these are offered online with ongoing access.[7][20]
